![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Remove the unused JUnit `assertDoesNotThrow` import, as we can simply invoke the method directly. If an exception is thrown, the test will fail naturally.

```suggestion
import com.google.cloud.ReadChannel;
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Use Google Truth (assertThat) for all assertions. Do not use JUnit assertions. <sup>([link](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/gcs-analytics-core/blob/main/.gemini/styleguide.md))</sup>
</details>
